errors.evidence: Description states the y-axis for new cases goes up to 180,000, but the figure shows it goes up to approximately 180,000.
Description states the range for news reports is 0 to 6,000, but the figure shows it goes up to approximately 3,500.
The description fails to mention the specific type of data represented by the bar chart (count of new cases) and the line chart (count of media reports).
The description does not mention the presence of dual y-axes, which is crucial for interpreting the figure.
The phrase '表现出新闻数量与新增病例之间的某种关系' is vague and lacks clarity on the nature of the relationship.
